original_record.question_en: List every TR that affected TS 38.211 and its impact type (revision history of 38.211).
original_record.cypher: MATCH (sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.211'})<-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]-(ti:TRImpact)<-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]-(tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, ti.impactType, ti.affectedSection, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY tr.trNumber

author_CQ_record.question: TS 38.211에 영향을 준 모든 TR 목록과 각각의 영향 유형은? (38.211 개정 이력 분석용)
author_CQ_record.cypher: MATCH (sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.211'})<-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]-(ti:TRImpact)<-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]-(tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, ti.impactType, ti.affectedSection, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY tr.trNumber

scope_rule: Preserve original TS38.211 inverse research-to-specification history and every TR/type. Five projected columns provide supporting original-query evidence; no additional mandatory answer field or arbitrary release cutoff is invented.
